site.name: Sweet Papa Pedals
site.tagline: Six free pedals for indie-rock production
site.description: Free VST3 & AU audio plugins for indie rock and bedroom pop — vocal doubler, ducked reverb, tape wobble, saturation, ambient wash and a 12-character multi-FX. macOS & Windows. By Sweet Papa Technologies.

installNotes.mac: Download the .pkg, double-click, done — installs AU + VST3 for every DAW (GarageBand, Logic, Ableton, Reaper…). If macOS warns about the developer, right-click the pkg and choose Open.
installNotes.win: Download the installer .exe and run it — installs the VST3s to the standard folder. Rescan plug-ins in your DAW.

pedals.name: DOUBLE
pedals.short: Instant doubled takes: up to four micro-detuned voices that wander in pitch, timing and level like real players. Your dry signal passes untouched.
long: DOUBLE is the take you didn't record. It layers up to four micro-detuned voices (±4–14 cents) under your dry signal — and unlike a chorus, every voice slowly wanders in pitch, timing and level, the way a singer or guitarist actually drifts between takes.
The dry path is never touched. The doubles are high-passed so they thicken without mud, the stereo spread folds down mono-safe, and the three modes re-voice the wet bus for vocals, guitars or synths.

pedals.name: BACKPORCH
pedals.short: A short, dark production space that ducks out of the way while you play and breathes back in the gaps. Put it on a lead vocal at 50% and never worry.
long: BACKPORCH is a reverb built backwards: instead of giving you a science panel to keep the tail from swamping your mix, the mix hygiene IS the pedal. The send is high-passed, the tail is pre-delayed behind the source, and a built-in ducker pushes the space down while you sing or play, letting it bloom back in the gaps.
Three rooms — a dark slapback echo, a small studio room, and a plate — each tuned so any knob position sits in a mix. This is the 'expensive record' space, not the 'demo drowned in reverb' space.

pedals.name: SWAY
pedals.tagline: Makes static tracks move like a band
pedals.short: Subtle wow & flutter, drifting ensemble chorus, and breathing tremolo — driven by drift engines so nothing ever sits perfectly still.
long: Perfectly static tracks are the fingerprint of cheap digital. SWAY adds the slow, organic movement of tape machines and old ensembles: every LFO inside is detuned and drifted by filtered noise, so even one knob past zero makes a synth or DI guitar feel played rather than programmed.

Tape mode is wow/flutter pitch drift. Ensemble is a three-voice chorus where each voice has its own wandering clock. Pump is a tremolo that breathes — the quiet half of the cycle also darkens slightly, like a tube amp working.

controls.name: COLOR
controls.desc: Per-mode flavor: wow↔flutter / spread / trem shape

pedals.name: VROOM
pedals.tagline: The dirt pedal that lands in the mix
pedals.short: Four voices of touch-responsive dirt — tube warmth, crunch, fuzz, octave fuzz — with a loudness-compensated drive knob that changes texture, not volume.
long: VROOM is a saturator that responds to how you play: an envelope follower shifts the bias point and squashes the headroom as you dig in, so it compresses and blooms on hard attacks and cleans up as notes decay — the behavior that makes real tube amps feel like instruments.

Four voices (Smooth tube, Crunch, Fuzz, Octave fuzz) each have their own tone shaping into and out of the clipper. The DRIVE knob is loudness-compensated so turning it up adds texture instead of just volume, and source modes re-voice the whole pedal for electric, acoustic, or bass.

controls.name: TONE
controls.desc: Dark to bright, alive across its whole travel

controls.name: LEVEL
controls.desc: Output, with a transparent safety clip

pedals.name: DAYDREAM
pedals.tagline: One knob, from warm tape to dream
pedals.short: One knob is the whole manual: warm tape saturation, then wobble and width, then a shimmering near-infinite wash that ducks under your playing.
long: DAYDREAM is a journey on a single knob. The first third is warm tape — hysteresis saturation that dulls and squashes like real oxide. The middle adds wow, flutter and width. The top opens a shimmering, octave-climbing reverb wash with near-infinite decay — that automatically ducks out of the way while you play, so even maximum dream never buries the song.
There is nothing else to learn. Turn it until it feels right.

controls.name: DREAM
controls.desc: The whole pedal on one knob

pedals.name: FOFOPEDAL
pedals.short: Twelve hand-tuned characters — each is one produced sound, from 'Front Porch' to 'Vapor Trail' — and a single MIX knob that means 'how much pedal'.
long: FOFOPEDAL is a six-block effect chain (character, drive, modulation, pitch, delay, space) curated into twelve named characters, each voiced for a source and a vibe: Front Porch is an acoustic hall. Cassette Sunday is a warbling tape. Dub Lounge is a ping-pong tape echo. Cathedral Larynx turns a vocal into a shimmering cathedral.

The MIX knob is the magnitude of the whole character — zero is clean, 70 is the tuned sound, 100 is full send. Delay repeats and reverb tails are ducked under your playing automatically. Deep per-block controls are there when you want them, ignorable when you don't.

controls.name: MIX
controls.desc: How much pedal — scales the whole character
